pages.title: Apply Across a Tree
pages.text: Create a Modifier node and set Modifier to mastery:tree. Add trigger, keyword bonus, or spell modifier effects. The node activates when purchased and enabled without consuming a spell modifier slot. Its owning tree supplies its damage filter.

pages.title: Fire-Only Scorch
pages.text: On the Fire tree, add a mastery:trigger effect selecting mastery:scorch_on_hit. The Fire tree has a damage filter with irons_spellbooks:fire in Elements. Fire weapon hits and Fire skills in that tree can apply Scorch; physical and other elemental hits cannot.

pages.title: Sub-Trees
pages.text: Inherit subtrees is enabled by default. Flame Blade inherits from Fire and Two-Handed through its root prerequisites. Filters still apply: inherited Fire Scorch requires Fire damage. Disabling Inherit subtrees limits native spells to the direct tree. Weapon hits use the damage filter.

pages.title: Buff a Keyword
pages.text: Add mastery:keyword_modifier. Select mastery:scorch and use Stacks, Damage, or Duration, plus their Percent fields. For example Damage percent 0.25 adds 25% per rank. Flat Duration 20 adds one second per rank. These bonuses retain the modifier’s tree and damage scope.
